text: Stripe webhooks locally: run `pnpm stripe:listen` (forwards to /api/webhooks/stripe). Without it, payment and refund status never update in dev.
All Stripe calls go through src/payments/stripe-client.ts, which pins the API version and sets idempotency keys. Don't import the stripe SDK anywhere else.
Money is integer minor units (amountMinor) plus a currency code. Round with the helpers in src/lib/money.ts; never use floats or toFixed().
Stripe fires charge.refunded on every partial refund. The webhook must sum the refunds on the charge, not assume one full refund.
Unit tests: `pnpm test:unit` (Vitest). Payments tests use the Stripe fake in test/fakes/stripe.ts; never call Stripe's test API from unit tests.
E2E: `pnpm e2e` (Playwright) after `pnpm db:reset && pnpm db:seed`. The seeded user buyer@example.test has a delivered order you can refund.
Prisma: change prisma/schema.prisma, then `pnpm prisma migrate dev --name <x>`. Never edit a migration folder that is already merged.
Server actions in app/**/actions.ts must call requireOrderOwner() before any mutation; the middleware only checks that the user is logged in.
Transactional emails are React Email components in src/emails/. Preview them with `pnpm email:dev` on port 3001.
Refunds are done manually by support in the Stripe dashboard; there is no refund code in the app.
Unit tests run with Jest: `npm test`.
Use pnpm. The packageManager field is set and npm installs fail in CI.
Product search runs on the Meilisearch index; reindex with `pnpm search:reindex` after changing src/search/mapping.ts.
Marketing pages under src/app/(marketing)/ are statically generated. Don't call cookies() or headers() there or the whole route turns dynamic.
The recommendations carousel reads /api/recs, owned by the data team. Change only the UI; never change the payload shape.
PR titles follow Conventional Commits with a scope, e.g. feat(payments): …; PRs are squash-merged.
Prefer server components. Add 'use client' only to leaf components that need state or effects.
Admin product image uploads go to the S3 bucket through presigned URLs from src/app/api/uploads/route.ts.
`pnpm check` runs typecheck, lint and unit tests. Run it before pushing; CI runs the same script.
Order emails are sent by the legacy Mailer service (src/mailer.ts) using SendGrid templates.
Gift cards are off for the de locale for regulatory reasons; the giftCards flag is false there.
Supported store currencies are EUR, GBP and USD; a store's currency is fixed when the store is created.
Storybook: `pnpm storybook` on port 6006. Stories live next to components as *.stories.tsx.
Refunds are allowed only within 30 days of delivery and never for digital items. The rule lives in canRefund() in src/payments/refund-policy.ts.
After a theme change, purge the CDN cache with the 'purge-cdn' GitHub Action; don't purge from the provider console.
